## Summary

Adds Episode 7, "Software with Taste with Geoffrey Litt," to the podcast site.

- New episode page [`content/episodes/ep07.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/content/episodes/ep07.md) with title, timestamps, and references from the issue, YouTube link, and publish date `2026-09-18` (from the RSS `pubDate`).

comments.body: For single line (short title) episodes can we still move the author name to the right place @sepo-agent ?

Yes — and here's exactly how it works today.

## What controls the author name position

On the episode cards ([`quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx#L99-L106)), the guest/author name (`.episode-guest`) is **absolutely positioned to the bottom-right** of the card content:

```scss
.episode-guest {
  position: absolute;
  right: 1rem;
  bottom: 0.6rem;   // anchored to the bottom of .card-content
}
```
([`quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss#L224-L232`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/styles/episodeCarousel.scss#L224-L232))

Because it's anchored to the bottom of `.card-content`, its vertical spot depends on how tall the title is. `.card-title` clamps to **2 lines** but has no reserved min-height, so a **single-line short title** makes the content box shorter and the name floats up out of place.

## How to move it back

There's a per-episode knob already wired up: the **`guestOffset`** frontmatter field, applied as `transform: translateY(${guestOffset}rem)` ([`EpisodeCarousel.tsx#L60`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx#L60) and [L102](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx#L102)). Ep07 currently has `guestOffset: 0`. A **positive value nudges the name down**, so a short-title card can be aligned by setting e.g. `guestOffset: 0.6` on that episode's frontmatter.

So two paths:

- **Quick, per-episode** — set `guestOffset` in the short-title episode's `.md` frontmatter (rem units; positive = down). Fits within this PR branch.
- **Robust, one-time fix** — give `.card-title` a `min-height` equal to two lines so single- and two-line titles occupy the same height, which keeps the bottom-anchored name aligned for *all* episodes and removes the need for per-episode `guestOffset` tuning.

## Next step

- To tune just this PR's episode: `@sepo-agent /fix-pr set guestOffset on ep07 so the author name aligns for its single-line title`
- To fix it globally (reserve 2-line title height): `@sepo-agent /implement give .card-title a min-height of two lines in episodeCarousel.scss so the author name aligns regardless of title length`

Send whichever you prefer and I'll make the change.

Short answer: a plain comment won't rebuild it — the preview only regenerates on pull_request events, not on `issue_comment`.

Looking at [`.github/workflows/preview.yml`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/.github/workflows/preview.yml#L2-L21), the preview job fires on `opened`, `synchronize`, `reopened`, and `labeled`. So to get a fresh one you have two options:

- **Push a new commit to the PR branch** (a `synchronize` event) — this agent branch (`agent/…`) auto-previews on every push, and the URL comment is updated in place.
- **Re-apply the `sepo-preview` label** (remove it, then add it back) — the `labeled` trigger only builds when the added label is exactly `sepo-preview`.

I can't kick the workflow off myself from this answer-only route, but the natural way to get a refreshed preview *with the author-name fix baked in* is to make the change we discussed — that push will regenerate the preview automatically.

- To do both at once: `@sepo-agent /fix-pr set guestOffset on ep07 so the author name aligns for its single-line title`

If you just want a rebuild of the current branch as-is, toggle the `sepo-preview` label off and on.

@sepo-agent /fix-pr Set guestOffset to 0 on content/episodes/ep07.md or otherwise copy ep00 and ep01 so that the offset isn't broken.  Make a note that short titles may need to be handled in this way.

**Sepo pushed fixes for this PR.** Branch: `agent/implement-issue-92/claude-35402388966`. Requested by @XenonMolecule.

<!-- sepo-agent-fix-pr-status -->

**Fixed the broken guest-name offset on Episode 7.**

- Root cause: `titleLetterSpacing: "-0.02em"` squeezed *"Software with Taste with Geoffrey Litt"* onto a single line, so the `guestOffset: 0` guest name collided with the title (verified by rendering the card in headless Chromium).
- Removed `titleLetterSpacing` from [`content/episodes/ep07.md`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/agent/implement-issue-92/claude-35402388966/content/episodes/ep07.md) and kept `guestOffset: 0`. The title now wraps to two lines and the guest name sits correctly beside line two — identical to the known-good ep02–ep04 cards.
- Added a note in [`quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/agent/implement-issue-92/claude-35402388966/quartz/components/EpisodeCarousel.tsx) documenting that short one-line titles need `guestOffset` (e.g. 1.275 like ep00/ep01) and that `titleLetterSpacing` should not be used to force a borderline title onto one line.

<details><summary>Why not just `guestOffset: 0` or a literal ep00/ep01 copy?</summary>

`guestOffset` was already `0`; the letter-spacing was the actual culprit. A literal ep00/ep01 copy (`guestOffset: 1.275`, no letter-spacing) renders badly here because ep07's longer title wraps to two lines, pushing the guest name off the card. Removing the letter-spacing is the smallest change that satisfies "keep guestOffset 0" and "offset isn't broken." The `titleLetterSpacing` field is still honored for ep05/ep06.

</details>

## Rubrics Update

No changes were committed to [`agent/rubrics`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/tree/agent/rubrics) from PR #94.

Added one draft rubric.

**Summary of changes**

Created `rubrics/coding_style/document-edge-case-workarounds.yaml` (status: `draft`, severity: `should`, weight: 3).

**Why:** In PR #94, XenonMolecule — the trusted requester who merged the PR — explicitly instructed `@sepo-agent /fix-pr ... Make a note that short titles may need to be handled in this way.` The agent responded by adding an explanatory comment in `EpisodeCarousel.tsx` documenting the guest-name/short-title collision, the `guestOffset` fix, and the `titleLetterSpacing` pitfall. This reveals a durable preference: pair minimal edge-case fixes with a documenting note so future contributors understand the non-obvious knob. Marked `draft` since it's a single observed instance.

**Skipped:** the preview-rebuild mechanics discussion, the RSS/ingest root-cause note, and the min-height global fix (moved to issue #95) — all one-off or task-specific. Bot/agent comments were treated as advisory only.
